pointerEventsNote: Qaphela: Imicimbi yesikhombi ivaliwe ukuze ukushaya kungazisusi lapho kudlulwa ngesikhombi
breakpointSizesNote: Osayizi baqanjwe ngobubanzi, hhayi ngedivayisi, ngakho isikali esifanayo sichaza i-viewport (amathimu) noma ububanzi besakhi uqobo (grid-plate). Iziguquguquki ze-CSS azikwazi ukusetshenziswa ngaphakathi kwama-media query, ngakho ngenisa izinombolo:
layoutWidthAliasesNote: Amathimu achaza izifunda zawo ngamagama esibizo {contentWidth}, {sidebarWidth}, {containerWidth} kanye no-{layoutGutter}. Izakhi zegridi zisebenzisa u-{gridGap} no-{gridItemSpacing}.
availableFunctionalColorsPolaris: Imibala Yokusebenza Etholakalayo Evela Kuthimu ye-Polaris
palettePickerIntro: Isibonelo sokuqala senkambu esiqhutshwa yirejista sezilungiselelo zokubukeka kwe-HAX, sisebenzisa imodeli yedatha yephalethi efanayo ne-DDD.
themePaletteDescription: Khetha iphalethi; leli nani libhalwa njengesibaluli se-data-palette ezingeni lethimu.
darkContextDescription: Ukubuka kuqala kokufundeka nesimo esikhethiwe ekuboniseni kwemodi emnyama.
spacingSides: Izinhlangothi: Phezulu (t), Kwesokudla (r), Phansi (b), Kwesobunxele (l), X (x), Y (y)
letterSpacingVariableNote: Isiguquguquki se-CSS siyafana negama lekilasi, nesiqalo esithi '--ddd-'
richTextHeading: Ukufometha kombhalo ocebile nokunye ukubonisa kwedatha
blockCodeExample: Nasi isibonelo sebhulokhi yekhodi eyodwa, kusetshenziswa ikilasi elithi 'block-code', liyaphindeka, kodwa ligwema igama lekilasi elijwayelekile elithi 'block'
highlightExampleText: Nansi inguqulo ende kakhulu Yombhalo Ogqamisiwe edlulela ngale kokuphela kwebhokisi lomngcele
defaultHrLine: Umugqa ovundlile ozenzakalelayo usebenzisa isakhi se-hr
hrDataPrimaryNote: Izakhi ze-hr nazo zamukela amanani e-data-primary, futhi zakhelwe ukusebenza kahle uma zibekwe ngaphakathi kwesakhi sesihloko
hrFitContentNote: Uma kuhlanganiswe ne-width: fit-content kusihloko uqobo, kungakhawulela ukudwebela kube ngqo embhalweni
variableLengthDesignTreatment: Noma, uma ufuna ubude obuguquguqukayo, sebenzisa i-design-treatment:
accentContrastNote: Qaphela: Umbala wokugcizelela ngeke usetshenziswe uma umbala oyinhloko ungahlangabezani nezidingo zokuqhathanisa
haxCapabilityGap: Igebe lekhono le-HAX: {components} ayinalo ikhono le-HAX. Le phethini ibhaliwe kodwa ayishicilelwa kujantshi wokufaka kuze kudalwe ukuxhunywa.
internalContractsIntro: Izivumelwano ezinqamula zonke izingxenye zangaphakathi kwezakhi (izihloko, izaziso, okugoqekayo, okushumekiwe, amaqoqo enkambu okuphatha). Yilokhu ikhono le-hax-pattern-library-audit elikulinganisayo; ukuphoqelelwa okubanzi kuyo yonke i-ecosystem kungumsebenzi wakamuva.
